# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.0.5

## Fixed

- **Cloud edition: Today looks the same on every device.** The card layout (order, sizes, hidden cards), the weather city, the heatmap colours, the habit shown in the frequency card, the page order and the calendar view now sync with your records. Browser, phone and the Mac app (online edition) show the same Today. Changes made on another device appear when you come back to the window.
- **Upgrading:** open the cloud edition in the browser you set up Today in first; it shares your existing layout and city. Theme, font and language stay per device.
- The weather chart no longer throws an error while switching cities.

## Unchanged

- Local edition: everything stays on the device. Cloud data format: one optional `prefs` field is added to the synced record; no migration.

## Roll back

Tag `v2.0.4` stays available.
